To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the system generates code for data analysis from declarative models; (2) the code is optimized for performance; and (3) the code is well-structured, readable, and maintainable, which makes it easy to understand and to use for the user.

We present a system for generating statistical data analysis programs from fully declarative models.  The system is based on schema-guided deductivesynthesis, a new program synthesis paradigm which combines deductive synthesis, symbolic-algebraic computations and schema-guided programming.  The generated programs are fully optimized and contain comments.
AUTOBAYES can synthesize code for a wide range of data analysis problems and can generate code of high quality, which is optimized for the problem and the target platform.

the development and application of program synthesis technology to data analysis tasks.
the development of a system for program synthesis from statistical models.
the automatic generation of data analysis software.

we have shown that it is possible to automatically generate code for a large class of data analysis problems from statistical models.

the synthesis of statistical data analysis programs can be achieved with a high degree of automation, provided a sufficiently expressive schema language is available.
